sentences.zh: 又定明漢口本國領事應辦本國交涉事宜，系湖南、陝西、甘肅三省。

translations.literal: It was further fixed that the German consul at Hankou should handle German affairs in Hunan, Shaanxi, and Gansu provinces.
translations.idiomatic: It was further stipulated that the German consul at Hankou would handle German affairs in Hunan, Shaanxi, and Gansu.

sentences.zh: 湖北除歸宜昌領事辦理各府外，並江西省之袁州府等處，悉歸漢口本國領事經理。

translations.literal: In Hubei, apart from prefectures under the consul at Yichang, and Yuanzhou prefecture in Jiangxi and similar places, all are under the German consul at Hankou.
translations.idiomatic: In Hubei, except for prefectures under the Yichang consul, and Yuanzhou prefecture in Jiangxi and similar districts, all would fall under the Hankou consul.

sentences.zh: 至駐江甯府領事應辦本國交涉事宜，系安徽、江西二省。

translations.literal: The consul stationed at Jiangning should handle German affairs in Anhui and Jiangxi provinces.
translations.idiomatic: The consul at Jiangning would handle German affairs in Anhui and Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 除歸漢口領事之袁州府外，又江蘇省之江寧府等處」云云。

translations.literal: Apart from Yuanzhou prefecture under the Hankou consul, and Jiangning prefecture in Jiangsu and similar places," and so forth.
translations.idiomatic: Apart from Yuanzhou under the Hankou consul, and Jiangning prefecture in Jiangsu and similar districts," and so on.

sentences.zh: 是年德福親王來京覲見。

translations.literal: That year a German prince came to Beijing for an audience.
translations.idiomatic: That year a German prince came to Beijing for an audience with the throne.

sentences.zh: 德皇子婚禮，命出使德國大臣廕昌往賀，並派學生往柏林留學。

translations.literal: For the German crown prince's wedding, Minister to Germany Yinchang was ordered to convey congratulations, and students were dispatched to study in Berlin.
translations.idiomatic: For the German crown prince's wedding, Minister to Germany Yinchang was sent to offer congratulations, and students were dispatched to study in Berlin.

sentences.zh: 三十二年二月，德人始在津關請領聯單，赴新疆採買土貨。

translations.literal: In the second month of the thirty-second year, Germans first applied at the Tianjin customs for transit certificates to go to Xinjiang to purchase local goods.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the thirty-second year Germans first applied at the Tianjin customs for transit permits to travel to Xinjiang to buy local products.

sentences.zh: 三月，德使穆默牒中國，請派員往柏林商議無線電會約章，政府約二次開會再行核辦。

translations.literal: In the third month German Minister Mumm von Schwarzenstein memorialized China requesting dispatch of officials to Berlin to negotiate a wireless telegraphy convention; the government agreed to decide after a second meeting.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month German Minister Mumm von Schwarzenstein asked China to send officials to Berlin to negotiate a wireless telegraphy convention; the government agreed to decide after a second conference.

sentences.zh: 閏四月，德交還天津馬隊營盤等處房地，並砲隊、機器槍隊、屠牲場、養病院各房屋。

translations.literal: In the intercalary fourth month Germany returned at Tianjin the cavalry camp grounds and other properties, and the sites of artillery, machine-gun companies, slaughterhouse, and hospital buildings.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fourth month Germany returned to China at Tianjin the cavalry camp and other grounds, together with buildings used by artillery, machine-gun units, the slaughterhouse, and the hospital.

sentences.zh: 是月，德在營口改設正領事。

translations.literal: That month Germany established a full consul at Yingkou.
translations.idiomatic: That month Germany upgraded its post at Yingkou to a full consulate.

sentences.zh: 德使穆默回國，署使葛爾士牒中國，復以通商口岸限制洋人置地辦法與條約不符，請除限制，並謂德人地產收回公用，可會商。

translations.literal: The German minister Mumm returned home; the acting minister Kohler sent a note to China again stating that restrictions on foreigners purchasing land at treaty ports were inconsistent with treaty, requesting their removal, and saying that German property taken for public use might be discussed.
translations.idiomatic: After Minister Mumm returned home, Acting Minister Kohler petitioned China again, arguing that restrictions on foreign land purchases at treaty ports violated treaty obligations and asking that they be lifted; he also indicated that German property resumed for public use could be negotiated.

sentences.zh: 六月，德人李卜克在北京設立學堂，德使請中國攤出經費，不許。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, the German Ribbentrop established a school in Beijing; the German minister asked China to contribute funds; this was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, a German named Ribbentrop established a school in Beijing; the German minister asked China to contribute funds, but the request was refused.

sentences.zh: 三十三年四月，以孫寶琦為出使德國大臣，遞國書。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the thirty-third year, Sun Baoqi was appointed minister to Germany and presented credentials.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the thirty-third year, Sun Baoqi was appointed minister to Germany and presented his credentials.

sentences.zh: 是月，外務部咨改訂青島租界製成貨物徵稅新章。

translations.literal: That month the Foreign Ministry memorialized regarding revision of new regulations on taxation of manufactured goods in the Qingdao concession.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Foreign Ministry issued instructions to revise the regulations on taxation of manufactured goods in the Qingdao concession.

sentences.zh: 初，青島設關徵稅一事，已於與德使海靖議定辦法，嗣於三十一年又與德使穆默修改，其大意即系德國允在海邊劃一地界，作為停泊船隻、起下貨物之定所，凡出口貨在未下船以前，即完出口稅，進口貨除軍用各物暨租地內所用機器並建修物料免稅外，其餘百貨，於起岸後未出新定之界以前，即完進口稅，關員在彼辦理，德國相助無阻。

translations.literal: Initially, the matter of establishing customs and levying duties at Qingdao had been settled with the German minister Heyking; in the thirty-first year it was revised again with Minister Mumm. The gist was that Germany permitted a zone to be marked off along the shore as a place for vessels to anchor and goods to be loaded and unloaded; export goods paid export duty before being shipped; import goods, except military articles and machinery and building materials used within the leased territory, paid import duty after landing and before leaving the newly defined zone; customs officers worked there, and Germany offered assistance without obstruction.
translations.idiomatic: Customs and duties at Qingdao had first been arranged with Minister Heyking and revised in the thirty-first year with Minister Mumm. Germany agreed to designate a coastal zone for anchorage and cargo handling: export duties were collected before goods were shipped; import duties, except on military supplies and machinery and building materials for use within the lease, were collected after landing and before goods left the designated zone; Chinese customs officers operated there with German cooperation.

sentences.zh: 又由中國允每於結底，將本結所收進口稅提出二成，撥交青島德國官憲應用。

translations.literal: China also agreed that at each settlement twenty percent of import duties collected would be turned over to the German authorities at Qingdao for their use.
translations.idiomatic: China also agreed that at each settlement period, twenty percent of import duties collected would be allocated to the German authorities at Qingdao.

sentences.zh: 既因續訂章程，德租界內製成貨物徵稅一條，語義未盡，因與德使葛爾士再訂徵稅新章。

translations.literal: Because the article on taxation of manufactured goods within the German concession in the revised regulations was not fully clear, new tax regulations were again drawn up with Acting Minister Kohler.
translations.idiomatic: Because the provision on taxation of manufactured goods within the German concession remained ambiguous in the revised regulations, new tax rules were negotiated with Acting Minister Kohler.

sentences.zh: 初，中國欲修天津至鎮江鐵路，與德、英借款，已立合同。

translations.literal: Initially China wished to build a railway from Tianjin to Zhenjiang and had already concluded a loan contract with Germany and Britain.
translations.idiomatic: China had originally planned a railway from Tianjin to Zhenjiang and had already signed a loan contract with Germany and Britain.

sentences.zh: 至是，直隸、江蘇、山東三省京官請攬歸自修，命張之洞、袁世凱商辦，議改合同，德、英執不允。

translations.literal: At this point Beijing officials from Zhili, Jiangsu, and Shandong requested that it be taken over for self-construction; Zhang Zhidong and Yuan Shikai were ordered to negotiate; they sought to alter the contract, but Germany and Britain firmly refused.
translations.idiomatic: At this point Beijing officials from Zhili, Jiangsu, and Shandong petitioned to build the line with domestic funds; Zhang Zhidong and Yuan Shikai were ordered to negotiate a revised contract, but Germany and Britain refused.

sentences.zh: 乃又增派外務部右侍郎梁敦彥會同張之洞等籌議。

translations.literal: Liang Dunyan, Vice Minister of the Foreign Ministry, was then additionally appointed to deliberate jointly with Zhang Zhidong and others.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister of Foreign Affairs Liang Dunyan was then added to the negotiating team with Zhang Zhidong and others.

sentences.zh: 初，津鎮鐵路借款之開議也，德使增索接造支路二道，一由德州至正定，一由兗州至開封，為原議所無，不允。

translations.literal: When negotiations on the Tianjin–Zhenjiang railway loan first opened, the German minister additionally demanded two branch lines—one from Dezhou to Zhengding and one from Yanzhou to Kaifeng—which were not in the original plan; this was refused.
translations.idiomatic: When the Tianjin–Zhenjiang railway loan was first negotiated, the German minister additionally demanded two branch lines—from Dezhou to Zhengding and from Yanzhou to Kaifeng—which had not been in the original agreement; China refused.

sentences.zh: 德使乃始變計：一，允由膠澳至沂州府一段，仍作為津鎮支路，歸入官路；

translations.literal: The German minister then changed course: first, he agreed that the section from Jiaozhou to Yizhou prefecture would still count as a branch of the Tianjin–Zhenjiang line and be incorporated into the state railway;
translations.idiomatic: The German minister then changed his position: first, he agreed that the section from Jiaozhou to Yizhou would remain a branch of the Tianjin–Zhenjiang line under state control;

sentences.zh: 二，允由濟南府往山東界之一道，包入津鎮官路。

translations.literal: second, he agreed that the line from Jinan prefecture to the Shandong border would be included in the Tianjin–Zhenjiang state railway.
translations.idiomatic: second, he agreed that the line from Jinan to the Shandong border would be included in the Tianjin–Zhenjiang state railway.

sentences.zh: 中國亦允由德州至正定府及由兗州府或幹路中之他處過濟寧州至開封府兩支路，於十五年內由中國自行籌辦，並聲明儻用洋款，須向德華公司商借。

translations.literal: China also agreed that the two branch lines from Dezhou to Zhengding and from Yanzhou or another point on the main line via Jining to Kaifeng would be built by China on its own within fifteen years, and declared that if foreign funds were used, loans must be negotiated with the Sino-German company.
translations.idiomatic: China also agreed to build within fifteen years the two branch lines from Dezhou to Zhengding and from Yanzhou or another point on the main line via Jining to Kaifeng, declaring that any foreign loans for the purpose must be negotiated with the Sino-German company.

sentences.zh: 至是遂由梁敦彥與德、英銀行等改訂借款合同二十四款，名為中國國家天津浦口鐵路五釐利息借款。

translations.literal: At this point Liang Dunyan and the German and British banks revised the loan contract into twenty-four articles, entitled the Chinese Imperial Tianjin–Pukou Railway Five Percent Loan.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Dunyan then revised the loan contract with the German and British banks into twenty-four articles, titled the Chinese Imperial Tianjin–Pukou Railway Five Percent Loan.

sentences.zh: 既定議，即由外務部牒德使，聲明膠沂、濟東路線應作為津鎮支路，其由德州至正定、兗州至開封支路，均由中國自造。

translations.literal: Once settled, the Foreign Ministry sent a note to the German minister declaring that the Jiaozhou–Yizhou and Jinan–east Shandong lines should count as branches of the Tianjin–Zhenjiang railway, while the Dezhou–Zhengding and Yanzhou–Kaifeng branches would be built by China itself.
translations.idiomatic: Once agreement was reached, the Foreign Ministry notified the German minister that the Jiaozhou–Yizhou and Jinan–eastern Shandong lines would be treated as branches of the Tianjin–Zhenjiang railway, while the Dezhou–Zhengding and Yanzhou–Kaifeng branches would be built by China.

sentences.zh: 已，復與德議訂電政合同，即青、煙、滬水線交接辦法，並購回京沽軍線條款，及山東鐵路附設電線辦法章程共十四款。

translations.literal: Thereafter a telegraph agreement was negotiated with Germany—fourteen articles covering connection of the Qingdao, Yantai, and Shanghai cable lines, terms for repurchase of the Beijing–Taku military line, and regulations for telegraph wires along the Shandong railway.
translations.idiomatic: A telegraph agreement was then negotiated with Germany in fourteen articles, covering the connection of the Qingdao, Yantai, and Shanghai cable lines, repurchase of the Beijing–Taku military line, and regulations for telegraph wires along the Shandong railway.

sentences.zh: 是年，德柏林賽衛生民學會及萬國玩耍排列館請中國派員入會，許之。

translations.literal: That year the Berlin Hygiene Exhibition Society and the International Exposition of Amusements invited China to send representatives; permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Berlin Hygiene Exhibition and the International Amusement Exposition invited China to send delegates; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 三年，山東巡撫孫寶琦與德訂收回各路礦權合同。

translations.literal: In the third year, Shandong governor Sun Baoqi concluded with Germany a contract for recovery of mining rights along the various lines.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, Shandong Governor Sun Baoqi concluded with Germany a contract for the recovery of mining rights along the various railway lines.

sentences.zh: 初，德商礦務公司照約在坊子、馬莊開礦，屢禁華人在附近開礦，爭執有年。

translations.literal: Initially the German mining company had opened mines at Fangzi and Mazhuang under treaty and repeatedly forbade Chinese to mine nearby; disputes had continued for years.
translations.idiomatic: The German mining company had operated mines at Fangzi and Mazhuang under treaty and repeatedly barred Chinese from mining nearby, leading to years of dispute.

sentences.zh: 迨津浦借款合同簽定，又要索膠沂、津浦路內礦權，並請封禁大汶口華礦，政府不許。

translations.literal: After the Tianjin–Pukou loan contract was signed, they again demanded mining rights along the Jiaozhou–Yizhou and Tianjin–Pukou lines and asked that Chinese mines at Dawenkou be closed; the government did not permit this.
translations.idiomatic: After the Tianjin–Pukou loan was signed, they again demanded mining rights along the Jiaozhou–Yizhou and Tianjin–Pukou lines and asked that Chinese mines at Dawenkou be shut down; the government refused.

sentences.zh: 於是德使照會始有劃清礦權之語。

translations.literal: Only then did the German minister's note speak of demarcating mining rights.
translations.idiomatic: Only then did the German minister's note propose demarcating mining rights.

sentences.zh: 孫寶琦即派道員蕭應椿等與德公司總辦畢象賢、領事貝斯商議收回，而畢象賢等則以中國欲收回三路礦權，須以相當之利益互換，否則不允。

translations.literal: Sun Baoqi at once sent Intendant Xiao Yingchun and others to negotiate recovery with the German company's director Bi Xiangxian and Consul Best, but Bi Xiangxian and others held that if China wished to recover mining rights on the three lines, equivalent benefits must be exchanged, or they would not agree.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Baoqi dispatched Intendant Xiao Yingchun and others to negotiate recovery with the company's director Bi Xiangxian and Consul Best, but they insisted that recovery of mining rights on the three lines required equivalent compensation in return.

sentences.zh: 初議淄、博礦界，公司第一次繪送礦界圖，系淄川全境，並毗連博山，蕭應椿等以淄、博窮黎向以採煤為衣食，若兩境全為公司所有，勢必至華民無以為生，因議博境全留，淄境各半，以天臺、昆侖兩山為界，山北歸公司，山南歸華人，公司未允。

translations.literal: Negotiations first concerned the Zibo and Boshan mining boundaries; the company first submitted a map covering all of Zichuan and adjoining Boshan. Xiao Yingchun and others argued that the poor of Zibo and Boshan had long lived by coal mining and that if both districts fell entirely to the company, Chinese would have no livelihood; they therefore proposed leaving all of Boshan and half of Zichuan, with Tiantai and Kunlun mountains as the boundary—north to the company, south to Chinese—but the company did not agree.
translations.idiomatic: Talks first addressed the Zibo and Boshan boundaries; the company's initial map claimed all of Zichuan and adjoining Boshan. Xiao Yingchun argued that local people had long depended on coal mining for their livelihood and that ceding both districts would leave Chinese without means of support; he proposed retaining all of Boshan and half of Zichuan, with Tiantai and Kunlun mountains as the boundary—north to the company, south to Chinese—but the company refused.

sentences.zh: 蕭應椿因親赴淄川會畢象賢查勘，並邀集紳董礦商，旋議定淄川東南境由大奎山起斜經龍口鎮西北至淄川東境為界，界南礦產歸華商辦理，博山亦全讓還，次議淄川華礦，次議濰縣礦界，次議金嶺鎮鐵礦，次議償給勘礦購地費。

translations.literal: Xiao Yingchun went in person to Zichuan to meet Bi Xiangxian on inspection and convened local gentry and miners; they then agreed on a boundary in southeast Zichuan from Dakuishan slanting northwest via Longkou to the eastern border of Zichuan, with minerals south of the line reserved for Chinese merchants; Boshan was fully returned; next they discussed Chinese mines in Zichuan, then Weixian boundaries, then the Jinlingzhen iron mine, then compensation for survey and land purchase.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Yingchun traveled to Zichuan to survey the area with Bi Xiangxian and convened local gentry and miners; they agreed on a boundary in southeast Zichuan from Dakuishan northwest via Longkou to the eastern border, with minerals south of the line reserved for Chinese operators; Boshan was fully restored; negotiations then proceeded on Chinese mines in Zichuan, Weixian boundaries, the Jinlingzhen iron mine, and compensation for survey and land costs.

sentences.zh: 自是公司已成之膠濟鐵路，未成之津浦鐵路，甫勘之膠沂路，及曹州教案條約許與公司之三十里礦權，均允取消。

translations.literal: Thereupon the company agreed to cancel mining rights along the completed Jiaoji railway, the uncompleted Tianjin–Pukou railway, the newly surveyed Jiaozhou–Yizhou line, and the thirty-li zones granted the company under the Caozhou missionary treaty.
translations.idiomatic: The company then agreed to relinquish mining rights along the completed Jiaoji Railway, the uncompleted Tianjin–Pukou Railway, the newly surveyed Jiaozhou–Yizhou line, and the thirty-li zones granted under the Caozhou missionary treaty.
